messages:
sam: heads up — spotted weirdness in cost dashboard: prefetch credit totals jump when a route toggles canary -> prod. Anyone seen this?
laura: yeah noticed that last week on demo tenant, looked like double-counting during sticky-routing handoff
kai: timeline?
sam: sequence: canary gets traffic split 10/90 then sticky routing reassigns session -> prefetch credited to old route but later attributed to new route again after cache warmup
chris: maybe we're attributing both prefix cache hit and KV reuse separately without lineage join
maria: proposal: propagate an invocation lineage id across routing hops and store prefetch_origin_id with each cache credit
sam: agree. but how to handle rollouts & sampling? can't add sampling -> lose accuracy
laura: keep sampling, but prefer deterministic assignment for credits: if lineage_id exists, mark credit final; only sample when lineage missing
kai: dashboard UX: show "resolved lineage" toggle to include/exclude inferred credits
chris: also need telemetry: emit metric `cache.credit.{tenant}.{resolved}` and tag `lineage.present:true|false`
maria: +1. Also we should cap attribution window to 5m to avoid long tail double counts
sam: short pseudo-SQL for aggregation i sketched:
```
-- credit aggregation: prefer lineage
SELECT
  COALESCE(lineage_origin, cache_key) as credit_key,
  SUM(credit_amount) as credits
FROM cache_credits
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY credit_key;
```
laura: nice. ops concerns: how do we migrate old credits? retroactive fixes will affect billing
kai: treat retroactive as reporting-only; billing uses committed view locked at invoice time
maria: ops: add alert if weekly prefetch credits delta > 15% for a tenant during rollouts
sam: can we add an API field in rollout config to set 'credit_policy': ['prefer_lineage','per_route'] ?
chris: +1, makes it explicit. default prefer_lineage
deploy-bot: canary rollout crediting-policy=prefer_lineage deployed to staging
laura: follow-ups: (1) telemetry event schema, (2) dashboard toggle, (3) migration doc for billing team
sam: I'll own onboarding doc. Can someone file jira for telemetry schema?
maria: I'll create jira and ping billing
sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
